5번째 가로줄의 파란 세 칸에는\n메모가 1, 5, 7, 9 네 숫자뿐입:
The three blue cells in row 5
have only notes 1, 5, 7, 9.
They are an almost locked set (ALS)
with four digits in three cells.
초록 칸에는 메모가 5와 7 두 숫자뿐입니다.\n한 칸에 숫자가 두 개인:
The green cell has only notes 5 and 7.
It is an almost locked set
with two digits in one cell.
7은 두 집합에 모두 있습니다.\n파란 칸의 7과 초록 칸의 7은\n같은:
7 is in both sets.
The blue 7s and the green 7
are in the same box,
so 7 can go in only one of the two sets.
경우 1: 만약 파란 칸에 7이 들어가지 않으면\n파란 세 칸은 1, 5:
Case 1: If 7 doesn't go in the blue cells, the three blue cells become a locked set of 1, 5, 9, and 5 goes in one of the blue cells.
Then note 5 is removed from cells that see every blue 5.
경우 2: 만약 파란 칸에 7이 들어가면\n초록 칸은 5가 됩니다.\n그:
Case 2: If 7 goes in a blue cell,
the green cell becomes 5.
Then note 5 is removed from cells
that see the green cell.
Either way, 5 goes in
a blue cell or the green cell.
그래서 파란 칸과 초록 칸의 5와\n모두 겹치는 칸에서 메모 5를 지웁니:
So remove note 5 from cells that see
every 5 in the blue and green cells.
칸보다 숫자가 하나 많은\n거의 잠긴 집합 두 개를 찾아\n칸을 눌러 보:
Find two almost locked sets
with one more digit than cells,
and tap their cells.
Right. That cell is in an almost locked set.
A cell with only one note isn't an almost locked set.
이제 두 집합에 모두 있는 숫자를 보고\n메모를 지울 수 있는 칸을 눌러:
Now look at the digits in both sets
and tap a cell where a note can be removed.
이미 찾은 거의 잠긴 집합의 칸이에요. 집합 밖에서 지울 메모를 찾아 보: That cell is in a set you already found. Look outside the sets for a note to remove.
표시한 칸은 3이 들어갈 수 있는 자리예요. 빨간 칸과 겹치지 않아서 지: The marked cell is a spot where 3 can go. It doesn't see the red cell, so it can't be removed.
Right. It sees all three spots where 3 can go, so note 3 is removed.
1. 두 거의 잠긴 집합에 모두 있는 숫자 중\n두 집합에서 서로 모두: 1. Among the digits in both almost locked sets, find one whose cells in each set all see each other.
2. 두 집합에 모두 있는 다른 숫자를 확인합니다.\n그 숫자는 두 집합:
2. Check the other digit in both sets.
That digit must go in one of the two sets.
3. 두 집합의 그 숫자와 모두 겹치는 칸에서\n그 숫자의 메모를 지웁니: 3. Remove that digit's note from cells that see that digit in both sets.
초록 칸과 파란 세 칸을 합치면\n네 칸에 숫자도 1, 5, 7, 9 네:
Together, the green cell and the three blue cells make four cells with four digits: 1, 5, 7, 9.
The four cells aren't all in one line or box, so they aren't a locked set.
네 숫자를 W, X, Y, Z라고 하면\n7은 두 집합을 잇는 숫자(X):
Call the four digits W, X, Y, Z.
7 is the digit linking the two sets (X), and 5 is the digit removed (Z).
The name WXYZ-Wing comes from the four digits.
